# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "weather", "description": "Get weather", "parameters": {"properties": {"city": {"description": "City name", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["city"], "type": "object"}}}
</tools>

For function call returns, you should first print <tool_calls>For each function call, you should return object like:
<tool_call>function_name
```json
function_arguments_in_json_format
```</tool_call>At the end of function call returns, you should print </tool_calls><｜hy_place▁holder▁no▁3｜><｜hy_User｜>Weather in Paris?/think<｜hy_Assistant｜><tool_calls><tool_call>weather
```json
{"city":"Paris"}
```</tool_call></tool_calls></s><｜hy_User｜><tool_responses><tool_response>rainy & cold</tool_response></tool_responses><｜hy_Assistant｜><think>
